title: armeria maritima var. castellana
intro: Armeria maritima var. castellana, commonly known as Sea Thrift or Castellana Sea Thrift, is a variety of the Sea Thrift plant, which is a flowering perennial native to coastal areas. The health benefits of Armeria maritima var. castellana include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help in reducing inflammation and preventing infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include antioxidant, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory activities, which can be used to treat various health conditions such as wounds, skin infections, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Armeria maritima var. castellana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
